externals.name: Stripe
externals.summary: The card network the ledger moves money through. Nobody in the estate provides it; the copy of its document beside the ledger's adapter is narrowed to the four operations the ledger calls, and is all the catalog claims about it.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Unique identifier for the object.

fields.name: object
fields.doc: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Optional. Amount intended to be collected by this PaymentIntent. A positive integer representing how much to charge in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal) (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00 or 100 to charge ¥100, a zero-decimal currency). The minimum amount is $0.50 US or [equivalent in charge currency](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#minimum-and-maximum-charge-amounts). The amount value supports up to eight digits (e.g., a value of 99999999 for a USD charge of $999,999.99).

fields.name: amount_capturable
fields.doc: Optional. Amount that can be captured from this PaymentIntent.

fields.name: amount_received
fields.doc: Optional. Amount that this PaymentIntent collects.

fields.name: capture_method
fields.doc: Optional. Controls when the funds will be captured from the customer's account.

fields.name: currency
fields.doc: Optional. Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional. An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.

fields.name: metadata
fields.doc: Optional. Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Learn more about [storing information in metadata](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-intents/creating-payment-intents#storing-information-in-metadata).

fields.name: status
fields.type: string enum(canceled | processing | requires_action | requires_capture | requires_confirmation | requires_payment_method | succeeded)
fields.doc: Status of this PaymentIntent, one of `requires_payment_method`, `requires_confirmation`, `requires_action`, `processing`, `requires_capture`, `canceled`, or `succeeded`. Read more about each PaymentIntent [status](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/intents#intent-statuses).

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Unique identifier for the object.

fields.name: object
fields.doc: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Amount, in cents (or local equivalent).

fields.name: currency
fields.doc: Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).

fields.name: metadata
fields.doc: Optional. Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.

fields.name: payment_intent
fields.doc: Optional. ID of the PaymentIntent that's refunded.

fields.name: reason
fields.type: string enum(duplicate | expired_uncaptured_charge | fraudulent | requested_by_customer) | null
fields.doc: Optional. Reason for the refund, which is either user-provided (`duplicate`, `fraudulent`, or `requested_by_customer`) or generated by Stripe internally (`expired_uncaptured_charge`).

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Optional. Status of the refund. This can be `pending`, `requires_action`, `succeeded`, `failed`, or `canceled`. Learn more about [failed refunds](https://docs.stripe.com/refunds#failed-refunds).

fields.name: type
fields.doc: The type of error returned. One of `api_error`, `card_error`, `idempotency_error`, or `invalid_request_error`

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Optional. For some errors that could be handled programmatically, a short string indicating the [error code](https://docs.stripe.com/error-codes) reported.

fields.name: decline_code
fields.doc: Optional. For card errors resulting from a card issuer decline, a short string indicating the [card issuer's reason for the decline](https://docs.stripe.com/declines#issuer-declines) if they provide one.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: Optional. A human-readable message providing more details about the error. For card errors, these messages can be shown to your users.

fields.name: param
fields.doc: Optional. If the error is parameter-specific, the parameter related to the error. For example, you can use this to display a message near the correct form field.
